query_scope.description: Fe/Si-containing Materials Project summary records for a broader tabular generalization case study.
query_scope.required_element_semantics: Use elements=["Fe", "Si"] and verify after acquisition that every returned formula/composition contains both Fe and Si.

deprecated_policy.rationale: Exclude records that Materials Project marks as deprecated.

theoretical_policy.rationale: Do not filter theoretical/non-theoretical status in the acquisition query; capture the field and audit the distribution after acquisition.

include_gnome_policy.rationale: Do not rely on the installed client default. Exclude GNoMe records for the first broader validation dataset unless a later study explicitly scopes them in.

target_filter_policy.rationale: Filtering by the target or a target-derived stability label would bias the target distribution.

ordering_policy: API order is not assumed deterministic; sort the saved tabular output by material_id after acquisition.

polymorph_policy.validation_grouping: group by reduced formula and chemical system for leakage checks

scientific_scope: Designed for model validation workflow planning, not for direct experimental claims.
Energy above hull is a computed stability proxy and should not be filtered during acquisition.
limitations: API call has not been executed in v1.3.1.
Returned row count and target distribution are unknown until v1.3.2 acquisition.
The elements parameter semantics must be verified by post-acquisition Fe/Si containment checks.
GNoMe exclusion is an explicit initial policy choice and can be revisited in a separate scoped study.
stop_conditions: Mandatory field missing from installed SummaryDoc or returned table.
Credentials, absolute local paths, or raw API responses appear in tracked artifacts.
Returned rows do not all contain both Fe and Si.
Valid target rows or grouping counts are too small for validation.
Database/package version cannot be recorded during live acquisition.
